summary.en: Jirokichi Suzuki bought some art pieces from someone in Hokkaido, and he wanted the potter Kenzo Ukishima to create a catalogue of the pieces, that is why Sonoko visits Ukishima’s house with the gift Jirokichi gave as a greeting. Conan is tagging along because Ran has gone shopping and he has nothing else to do. When the two arrive, they are welcomed by Ukishima holding a bandaged cat.

suspects: Tomoko Natsume, Miyuki Tachibana & Katsuyuki Adachi
